behaviors_asserted: Hono emits structured events through TracingChannel.
The TracingChannel 'hono:request' tracks individual middleware and route handler executions with context fields type, name, ctx.
TracingChannel propagates AsyncLocalStorage context through the middleware cascade.
TracingChannel provides lifecycle events start, end, error, asyncStart, and asyncEnd.
Subscribers attach externally and receive events automatically without requiring user-added middleware.
